wisp.crew.editor.name: Name
wisp.crew.editor.briefHint: What they always keep in mind. Each job adds what it asks
wisp.crew.editor.wakesHint: What else starts their jobs: an event, or another member's report (a hand-off)
wisp.crew.editor.need.name: Give them a name
wisp.crew.editor.bad.name: A name is letters, digits, spaces, . _ or -, up to 24
wisp.crew.editor.taken: Someone on your crew already has that name
wisp.crew.answer.title: Crew answers
wisp.crew.tpl.verify.name: Vera
wisp.crew.tpl.verify.brief: When a task finishes, check its work: read it with wisp_session, run the tests, try the change and look for what it missed. When something is wrong, send that task a follow-up saying exactly what to fix. When it holds up, stay quiet.
wisp.crew.tpl.ci.name: Scout
wisp.crew.tpl.ci.brief: Watch CI on the default branch (`gh run list`). When a run fails, find the cause in its logs (`gh run view <id> --log-failed`) and fix it on a branch, or say why it is flaky. When everything is green, stay quiet.
wisp.crew.tpl.review.name: Quill
wisp.crew.tpl.review.brief: Review pull requests that are new or changed since your last check-in (`gh pr list`, `gh pr diff`). Look for bugs, missing tests and risky changes, worst first, one short review per PR. Never push, approve or merge.
wisp.crew.tpl.triage.name: Sorter
wisp.crew.tpl.triage.brief: Read new GitHub issues. Spot duplicates, note missing repro steps, and list the ones worth doing first with a one-line plan each. Never close an issue.
wisp.crew.tpl.deps.name: Tinker
wisp.crew.tpl.deps.brief: Check for outdated and vulnerable dependencies (`npm outdated`, `npm audit`, or the project’s own). Update the safe ones on a branch, run the tests, and report what changed and what needs a decision.
wisp.crew.tpl.notes.name: Echo
wisp.crew.tpl.notes.brief: Read what merged this week (git log, merged PRs) and draft the CHANGELOG entries in the project’s voice. Leave them uncommitted for me to review.
wisp.crew.editor.importTitle: A member someone shared: a .crew.json file, its JSON or a link
wisp.crew.editor.handle.none: Pick a name you can type: you’ll reach them with @name
wisp.crew.editor.jobHint: in every job’s prompt, with what they remember
wisp.crew.editor.jobPlaceholder: What they look after, how you like it done, and what they should never do. E.g. Watch CI on main; fix failures on a branch; stay quiet when it’s green.
wisp.crew.editor.cronHint: on their own, between the jobs you give them
wisp.crew.editor.custom.say: Say it like you would to a person
wisp.crew.editor.eventsHint: with a job about that task, in their project (any, if they have none)
wisp.crew.editor.projectTitle: The project their jobs run in
wisp.crew.editor.parallelTitle: Jobs they run at the same time; more wait their turn
wisp.crew.org.title: Org
wisp.crew.org.choosing: Choosing {name}’s delegates: + adds a member, ✓ takes them off
wisp.crew.org.howText: A member’s delegates are who their jobs can hand work to: other crew members, or agents on any harness and model. Each arrow is one.
wisp.crew.org.alone: A job that was itself delegated works alone: it can’t pass the work on to another crew member, so members never hand work round in circles.
wisp.crew.org.nobodyYet: Nobody yet: pick members in the chart.
wisp.crew.org.nobodyFrom: Nobody on the crew. Any task can still hand them work with @{name}.
wisp.crew.import.title: Import crew members
wisp.crew.import.label: A shared member
wisp.crew.import.hint: A .crew.json file’s JSON, a share link, or v1’s gist (gist:<id>)
wisp.crew.import.passwordHint: This link has a password: ask whoever shared it.
wisp.crew.import.passwordWrong: That password didn’t open it. Check it with whoever shared it.
wisp.crew.import.paused: They start paused: resume each when you’re ready.
wisp.crew.editor.tintHint: the list’s very light tint while they’re picked on the rail
wisp.crew.list.name: Crew
wisp.crew.list.orgTitle: Org: who on your crew hands work to whom

wisp.crew.org.hintDrag: Arrows go from a member to their delegates. Select one to change who they hand work to. Drag a card to move it, or from its handle onto another to link them.
wisp.crew.org.hintTouch: Arrows go from a member to their delegates. Select one to change who they hand work to, then drag it to move it.
wisp.crew.org.resetTitle: Put everyone back in tiers, the way the chart lays itself out
wisp.crew.org.handle: Drag onto another member to make them {name}’s delegate
